proof_summary: At \(n=473165\), the endpoints are \(5292270077779\) and \(5292270077807\), while \(k=5292270077783\) lies strictly between them. A covering computation modulo \(48\) shows that for every \(j>0\), one of \(3,5,7,17,97,257,673\) properly divides \(k2^j+1\), so \(k\) is itself a Sierpiński number and the endpoints are not consecutive.
